title: KBN University Awarded $5M Grant for AI Ethics Research
summary: The grant will fund the new Center for Ethical AI, led by Dr. Evelyn Reed, to explore the societal impact of artificial intelligence.

title: Annual 'Innovate KBN' Competition Winners Announced
summary: A team of engineering students won first prize for their low-cost water purification system designed for developing nations.

title: Physics Department Observes New Exoplanet
summary: Using the university's new observatory, Dr. Sofia Rossi and her team have confirmed the existence of a new Earth-like planet.

title: Welcome Week 2024: A Resounding Success
summary: Over 2,000 new students joined the KBN family this fall, participating in a week of activities, workshops, and community-building events.

title: Business School Launches New Sustainability Program
summary: The new MBA concentration in Sustainable Business, championed by Dr. Marcus Thorne, will prepare leaders for a green economy.
